scope: Static recovery of the Dock's autohide timing, trigger geometry and slide model from the installed Dock executable. No process was executed, attached to or modified, and no preference was changed.

target.derivation: byte copy of the thin arm64e executable

providers.otool: otool -tV dump retained from the magnification pass; objc_msgSend stubs, CFString constants, float literals and ivar offsets resolved by research/local/dock-autohide/annotate_otool.py

0x100070534.role: -[DockBarMouseEventHandler _handleMoveEvent:type:]: MouseEntered arms the autohide-delay (or dig) timer, MouseMoved re-arms it beyond the 2 pt / 5 pt tolerance, MouseExited cancels it or posts the mouse-leave event

0x10006edbc.role: -[DockBarMouseEventHandler initWithConnection:]: reads autohide-delay (default 0.15 s) and the four digduration-* preferences

0x10007107c.role: -[DOCKPreferences autohideDelayPref]: proxy for the mouse handler's _autohideDelay

0x100070288.role: -[DockBarMouseEventHandler _mouseEnterHelper:location:allowSwitchingBetweenDisplays:]: posts the mouse-enter event, refuses while a button is held without a drag

0x10005f2c4.role: -[DockBar startAutoShow]: autoHide -> 0 over floor(ln(delta/2+1)+1) * autoHideSpeed ms

0x10005f59c.role: -[DockBar startAutoHide]: autoHide -> 1 over floor(ln(delta/2+1)+1) * autoHideSpeed ms

0x100095468.role: -[DockBar handleDockEventMouseEnter:]: myInBar from inBarRect, then startAutoShowAndShowAllWindows when hidden or hiding

0x1000956b8.role: -[DockBar handleDockEventMouseLeave:]: startAutoHide immediately when autoHideOn and nothing is being dragged

0x100098768.role: -[DockBar handleDockEventAutohideEnabled:setRect:context:]: preference change; hides at once unless the pointer is in inBarRect

0x100257e34.role: DockBar setup: creates the autoHide and fish properties with easing kind 1, autoHideSpeed = 60 * autohide-time-modifier, launch reveal 500 ms after start over 550 ms

0x1000502b4.role: DockFloatAnimatedProperty step: p = elapsed/duration, 0.5 - 0.5 cos(pi p) when the easing field is non-zero, then interpolate:

autohideDelaySeconds.role: delay between the pointer entering the edge strip and the show starting, when the Dock is hidden or hiding

autohideTimeModifierDefault.literal: fmov s0, #1.0 at 0x1002586e8 passed as the default to the float-preference helper 0x1000066c8

autoHideSpeed.readAt: mov w8, #0x42700000 (60.0f) at 0x1002586fc; fmul at 0x100258704; stored to DockBar.autoHideSpeed (ivar 420) at 0x100258710

slideDurationMilliseconds.deltaShow: |size - (distanceTop + tileSize + distanceBottom + currentFish - autoHideOffset)|, size = largeSize when magnifying and the pointer is in the bar while fish animates, else tileSize
slideDurationMilliseconds.defaultResult: 240 ms for the default geometry in both directions (delta 80 pt hiding, 74 pt showing)
slideDurationMilliseconds.range: 60 ms (delta < 3.44 pt) to 300 ms (delta >= 107.2 pt) at modifier 1.0; 240 ms for 38.2 <= delta < 107.2

easing.value: p' = 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(pi * p), p = clamp((now - start) / duration, 0, 1)
easing.readAt: 0x10005031c-0x100050344 in the property step 0x1000502b4; the easing field (+0x18) is set to 1 by the direct initialiser 0x1002dd2d8 called with w1 = 1 at 0x100258620-0x100258624 (autoHide) and 0x100258768-0x10025876c (fish)
easing.note: DOCK-MAGNIFICATION.md states the fish ramp is linear because no easing function is attached; the initialiser stores 1 in that field for both properties, so both ramps are cosine-eased. This should be re-checked in that unit.

hiddenOffset.readAt: 0x100081304-0x100081358 (FUN_1000812e8, called from the update loop at 0x100080150) and 0x10025868c-0x1002586c8 at setup
hiddenOffset.defaultResult: 90 pt for the default 64 pt tile: the 80 pt bar plus 10 pt, so no strip of the bar stays visible

pointerLeaveHideDelay.readAt: 0x100095870-0x100095880: handleDockEventMouseLeave: calls startAutoHide directly when autoHideOn; the MouseExited path 0x100070950-0x100070960 posts the leave event through DockEventQueue.addMouseLeave (0x100077298), which only coalesces

moveTolerancePoints.readAt: 0x100070c20-0x100070c4c: kCGMouseEventSubtype 0 selects 2.0, otherwise 5.0; a move farther than that from the armed point re-arms the delay timer at 0x100070c50-0x100070c84

edgeStripThicknessPoints.readAt: 0x1000130d8-0x100013100 (bottom), 0x10001316c-0x100013184 (left), 0x1000131f0-0x100013214 (right) in the bar-frame function 0x1000128f0; initial strip at 0x10005bd8c-0x10005be88 in -[DockBar activate]
edgeStripThicknessPoints.role: with autohide on, once the bar's in-bar band is thinner than 2 pt the event rect becomes a 2 pt strip along the whole stage edge

inBarBandAbovePoints.readAt: fmov s0, #-10.0 at 0x100012fbc (bottom), 0x100012f24 (left) and fmov s0, #10.0 at 0x100012e8c (right) in 0x1000128f0
inBarBandAbovePoints.role: the in-bar band and, with autohide on, the event rect reach 10 pt past the tiles' outer edge

backgroundEventMask.readAt: initial word at 0x1003fa108 (__DATA); loaded at 0x10005bea0, 0x100013274, 0x10025e35c, 0x10025e60c; bit 10 is added during drags at 0x1000b3edc and removed at 0x1000b4010

digDuration.role: replaces the autohide delay when the pointer enters from a non-user space (a full-screen app) or on another display with a mouse: the pointer must keep pushing toward the edge, with no more than perFrame between moves and within angle of the edge normal, for duration

launchReveal.readAt: 0x10025863c-0x100258680: autoHide starts at 1 (hidden) and animates to autoHideOn ? 1 : 0 starting mainMillis + 500 for 550 ms

geometryDefaults.tileSize: ceil(tilesize) when 0 < tilesize < 257, else 64 (52 when the main display is at most 800 pt tall)

autohideDefault.readAt: 0x1000086a4-0x1000086e8 reads the autohide boolean preference with default NO

model.events: The Dock registers a background-event shape with the window server (mask 0x360). The window server delivers MouseEntered (8), MouseExited (9) and MouseMoved (5) for that shape to -[DockBarMouseEventHandler _handleMoveEvent:type:].
model.shape: DockBar.rect, recomputed by the bar-frame function 0x1000128f0 on every update and pushed when it changes. Autohide off: the in-bar rect, [D(barLeft) - distanceSides, D(barRight) + distanceSides] along the edge and from 10 pt beyond the tiles' outer edge to the screen edge across it. Autohide on: the full stage length along the edge, same band across it; when that band is under 2 pt (bar hidden) it becomes a 2 pt strip along the whole screen edge.
model.show: MouseEntered while the Dock is hidden or hiding: arm a one-shot dispatch timer on the main queue for autohideDelay (0.15 s). A MouseMoved more than 2 pt (mouse) or 5 pt (tablet) from the armed point re-arms it. MouseExited cancels it. On fire, _mouseEnterHelper posts a mouse-enter event; handleDockEventMouseEnter: calls startAutoShowAndShowAllWindows, which animates autoHide from its current value to 0. While the Dock is visible, re-entry posts the event immediately.
model.hide: MouseExited with no timer pending posts a mouse-leave event; handleDockEventMouseLeave: calls startAutoHide at once (autoHide -> 1). No hide delay exists; only the slide duration applies.
model.offset: autoHideOffset = (distanceTop + tileSize + distanceBottom + 10) * autoHide.now, applied along the hide axis by the bar-frame function; 0 shown, bar height + 10 pt hidden.
model.duration: ms = floor(ln(delta / 2 + 1) + 1) * 60 * autohide-time-modifier; delta is the remaining travel described above. 240 ms for the default geometry.
model.curve: DockFloatAnimatedProperty with easing kind 1: now = from + (to - from) * (0.5 - 0.5 cos(pi * clamp(t / duration, 0, 1))).

workedExamples.note: default on displays at most 800 pt tall

limitations: Static reading only; no pointer, timer or frame timing was measured on the running Dock.
The window server's delivery latency for background MouseEntered/MouseExited events and dispatch's timer leeway (requested 0) are not in this binary.
stageWidth and stageHeight are DisplayDescriptor properties read as the usable edge length; their derivation from the display was not traced.
The dig-duration path, display switching, temporarily revealed Dock (DockVisibility) and the drag-leave path are recorded from the code but not modelled.
Addresses, offsets and constants are specific to build 26A5421a.

Three REA function runs ended in provider_timeout (330 s): 0x10007107c and 0x100098768 while a second Ghidra instance was running, 0x1000956b8 alone. All three were repeated successfully; the failed envelopes are kept as dock-fn-<address>.failed-<timestamp>.json.
